dissent: identical() demands exact() equality including envelope.source_generation; post-attestation staged pairs with valid-but-unpaired serials would be 'unrelated' even where pair_envelope could cover them — the disjunct is narrower than necessary in that corner, safe for soundness but it does not discharge completeness.
Authenticity reduces to the public TEST_KEY fixture HMAC (q_domain.py); the disjunct certifies original-object integrity, not real issuer authority, so 'identity' must not be read as trust.
findings: Obligation (derived): for every admitted schedule and every prefix p, accepted(s,a,pairs) holds iff differing_common_fields==[] AND differing_journal_fields==[] AND per-event responses_related; differing = strict-common minus at most {'staged'} (experiments/v3/cut-source-overnight/batch-07/identity.py:51-64; batch-06/adapter_traces.py:18-25; batch-05/semantic.py:13,102-111).

Staged disjunct premises are exact type/provenance only: identical() requires two 2-tuples (Envelope, payload), mutual typed equality, each envelope signed via checked_payload + own-body HMAC + token() generation, each payload == raw_cut(cut) (identity.py:16-21; semantic.py:24-32; batch-07/identity_audit.py:10-23); origin() requires the last 'stage' event with decision 'stage:ok' at the same index and literal action on both sides, staged typed-unchanged through p, digest-bound states (identity.py:24-48; identity_audit.py:26-50).

Non-narrowing discharged structurally: differing⊆common so strict_related⇒related, never narrower (identity.py:57,61); pairs must survive compare unchanged and incarnation_pair_established_by_identity=False, so the disjunct creates no authority (identity.py:53,58,64; eight-hour check.py audit_case 'identity creates no authority'); only 'staged' may be exempted.

Observation-vs-premise separation: both_sources_unattested, no_established_pairs, same_live_generation, own_current_stage_generation appear only in gap_certificate with acceptance_relation_changed=False, incarnation_pair_established=False (adapter_traces.py:29-45); identical/origin/proof never read source_name, the pair ledger, or live generation — satisfying validation-contract relation_non_narrowing.

Falsifiable clauses: any audited prefix with differing⊋{'staged'}; staged_rule='unrelated' while identical() holds; origin index/action mismatch or staged mutation after stage:ok; forged/corrupt identical staged accepted; pairs mutated by compare. Negative controls already exist: 'nonidentical-unattested-record-not-certified', 'identical-forged-unattested-records-not-certified', 'identical-corrupt-staged-payloads-not-certified' (adapter_traces.py run packet-C); 'future-stage-origin','cross-schedule-identity-proof','detached-prefix-hash','identity-creates-authority' (check.py main).

Missing premises before theorem-hood: (i) completeness — every reachable strict-failing prefix must have common⊆{'staged'} with alternative; only 240/40,320 orders per unit audited; 31,232 stale-collection and 8,848 incomplete-inventory per unit sit outside the packet04+08 union (inherited/remaining-scale-coverage-analysis.md); (ii) journal-overlay equality (a_domain.py:21-27) and delegated-Q coupling for all non-staged fields (inherited/prestage-correspondence-analysis.md obligation 1); (iii) reachable-shape qualification — staged pairs are candidate() products, not malformed injections; (iv) aligned stage:ok decisions so origins coincide.

Smallest decisive check: zero-execution audit replay — recompute compare()+identity_audit.check() at every prefix of every retained case (check.py audit_case ~99-128) and assert related with no 'unrelated' under identical-valid staged; one failing prefix refutes. Scale completeness additionally needs the boundary-01 proposal (192 orders/unit), currently new_executions_allowed=0.

summary: Derived proof obligation O26 and the exact conditional invariant for the accepted strict-or-staged relation from source. The accepted relation is strict field-pair correspondence (modulo the incarnation ledger) plus a staged-only disjunct gated on an origin certificate and authentic-object identity; the four packet facts (empty source_name, empty pairs, equal live generations, stage freshness) are diagnostics, not premises, matching the non-narrowing contract. Completeness at original scale remains unproven; smallest decisive check is a zero-execution audit replay over retained cases.
